fnol_text: My name is Nikhil Pereira and I live at 548 Cedar Road, Milton, VT 05446. You can reach me on (555) 437-3382 or nikhil.pereira@example.com. During the storm on 4 June 2024 high winds ripped tiles off the roof and rain came into the loft and the back bedroom. Policy HH-2023-00048. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Pereira on (555) 437-3382 to acknowledge the claim. Nikhil confirmed the loss date as 4 June 2024.
Site visit to 548 Cedar Road. Neighbour Elena Santos was present and confirmed the timeline.
